title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Illinois Wesleyan University
description: Ten under-21-safe food stops in Bloomington-Normal with late service documented by current restaurant, ordering, or local-business pages. Confirm same-day hours before leaving campus.

cards.title: The All-Night Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: Burgers, chicken, chili, and frozen desserts on West Market Street
cards.notes: Check the restaurant locator before departing, then use mobile ordering or the drive-thru for an overnight food run west of campus.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Bloomington option with a broad fast-food menu and mobile ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official location page identifies the restaurant at 1522 W. Market Street and lists both restaurant and drive-thru service as open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 1522 W. Market Street in Bloomington, IL
cards.access_notes: Official locator lists restaurant and drive-thru hours as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday; confirm holiday or temporary changes before travel.

cards.title: Breakfast at Any Hour
cards.subtitle: A round-the-clock diner east of central Bloomington
cards.notes: Use this sit-down option when the group wants breakfast, sandwiches, or dinner food after most kitchens have closed.
cards.short_summary: An all-day diner where breakfast and full meals remain available overnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official page lists 701 Eldorado Road in Bloomington as open 24 hours every day, with all-day breakfast, lunch, dinner, and walk-in service.
cards.source_title: Denny's Breakfast | 701 Eldorado Rd | Order Online
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday; contact the restaurant to confirm holiday hours.

cards.title: The North Main All-Nighter
cards.subtitle: Round-the-clock diner service in neighboring Normal
cards.notes: Choose this northbound diner when a seated meal matters more than proximity, and verify transportation for the return to campus.
cards.short_summary: A second 24-hour diner serving the broader Bloomington-Normal area.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official location page identifies 1615 N. Main Street in Normal and lists the restaurant as open 24 hours seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 24-hour service every day, including walk-ins and takeout; confirm holiday hours directly before making the longer trip.

cards.title: The 2 A.M. Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: Late drive-thru tacos and burritos west of downtown Bloomington
cards.notes: Order ahead and plan on drive-thru access after the dining room closes; the official page separates lobby and drive-thru hours.
cards.short_summary: A nightly drive-thru option that extends two hours beyond midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page lists the 1702 W. Market Street drive-thru as open until 2:00 a.m. every day and marks the location Open Late.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Bloomington, IL — 1702 W. Market St
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed as 9:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. daily; dine-in closes earlier, so use the drive-thru for service after 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: The 3 A.M. Grill Order
cards.subtitle: Late-night grilled and baked dishes on South Hershey Road
cards.notes: Review the live ordering page before traveling; it displays the restaurant address, menu, and current ordering schedule together.
cards.short_summary: A local grill whose direct ordering page carries service into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Wesley’s Grill's direct Toast ordering page identifies 1804 S. Hershey Road, Suite 10, and lists ordering hours through 3:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Wesley’s Grill Location and Ordering Hours
cards.access_notes: The direct ordering page lists closing at 3:00 a.m.; consult the live page immediately before ordering because displayed schedules may change.

cards.title: Pizza Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: Long-running neighborhood pizzeria on North Main Street
cards.notes: Place the order well before closing and specify dine-in, carryout, or delivery; Friday and Saturday provide the latest window.
cards.short_summary: A named North Main pizzeria with weekend service reaching midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Tobin's official menu identifies its Bloomington restaurant and lists hours until midnight on Friday and Saturday, with earlier closing on other nights.
cards.access_notes: Official menu lists 4:30 p.m.–midnight Friday and Saturday, 4:30–11:00 p.m. Monday–Thursday, and 11:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: The Midnight Pizza Pickup
cards.subtitle: Pizza, sandwiches, and sides on East College Avenue in Normal
cards.notes: Check the location page for the live closing time, order online, and allow enough travel time from campus before midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Normal carryout and delivery shop documented as serving until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official location page identifies the store at 1910 E. College Avenue in Normal and displays a closing time of midnight.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 1910 East College Ave in Normal
cards.access_notes: Official location page displayed service until 12:00 a.m. when fetched; recheck the live page because daily and holiday schedules may vary.

cards.title: Cookies After Midnight
cards.subtitle: Late-night bakery counter on East Beaufort Street
cards.notes: Use the current listing to compare weekday and weekend closing times, then order for pickup or delivery before the posted cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A dessert-focused stop with service extending past midnight on multiple nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Eat Local Bloomington-Normal's current business page identifies Insomnia Cookies at 117 E. Beaufort Street and lists closing at 1:00 or 3:00 a.m., depending on the night.
cards.access_notes: Listing shows midnight-or-later service nightly: 1:00 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and Sunday, and 3:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; verify before ordering.

cards.title: The Calzone Night Shift
cards.subtitle: Late-night calzone counter on East Beaufort Street
cards.notes: Check the direct ordering window before leaving Bloomington, then select pickup or delivery and submit the order ahead of cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A calzone shop with online ordering that continues beyond midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The direct D.P. Dough ordering page identifies the Normal shop at 121 E. Beaufort Street and lists online ordering through 12:45 a.m.
cards.source_title: D.P. Dough — Normal Pickup and Delivery
cards.access_notes: Direct ordering page lists online ordering from 10:30 a.m. to 12:45 a.m.; confirm the active window before travel or checkout.

cards.title: The 11 P.M. Cutoff
cards.subtitle: Late-evening drive-thru and mobile ordering in east Bloomington
cards.notes: Submit a mobile order before the posted cutoff, or use the drive-thru; do not assume service continues past 11:00 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A predictable late-evening option with an explicitly documented closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official restaurant page identifies 2507 E. Oakland Avenue and lists both lobby and drive-thru hours through 11:00 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: McDonald's at 2507 E Oakland Ave, Bloomington, IL
cards.access_notes: Official page lists lobby and drive-thru hours as 5:30 a.m.–11:00 p.m. Monday through Sunday; order before the stated cutoff.
